title: ilex verticillata
intro: Ilex verticillata, commonly known as Winterberry, is a deciduous shrub native to eastern North America. It is valued for its bright red berries, which provide important food sources for various birds and small mammals during the winter months. The health benefits of Ilex verticillata include its potential to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Winterberry include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
